metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Cassini clear-filter observations with fine detail from a green-filter image, projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

celestial.sunSource: Vendored JPL Saturn satellite orbit and the Archinal rotation frame documented with the PDS shape model.

panel.introduction: Daphnis travels inside the Keeler Gap in Saturn’s A ring. This tiny moon raises waves along the gap’s edges, while Cassini’s close views reveal ridges and a coating of fine material. The displayed 2026 orbit extrapolates a 2005–2018 fit; Horizons has no ephemeris at this date. Its orientation uses an arbitrary display phase, not a measured attitude.

controls.summary: Green-filter detail is combined with clear-filter images. Brightness matching reduces shading; the gray grid marks gaps.

controls.label: False color
controls.description: Cassini RED, GRN, BL1 filters displayed as red, green and blue; observed illumination and common coverage only.
controls.title: Cassini false color
controls.summary: Measured filter bands in false color; this does not reproduce human-visible color. Gray grid marks missing common coverage; photographed shadows remain.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 3.8 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Height relative to a 3.8 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
